about: The style and caption lab (scripts/velib/lab.py, ve lab): every drawable motion style and every caption look rendered on one window of one archived take of his, outside any piece, for one rating sitting (Krish, 4 Nov 2026: "we need to experiment carefully, as opposed to just producing videos experimentally and then seeing that they're shit").
The same reel, rendered again on every engine change and compared with the last, is the engine's regression check: the house look must not move.
The take is pinned by sha256 and fetched with scripts/post-pack/recording.py; media is never committed. Renders land in .cache/ve/lab/<engine>/; hashes and scores go to docs/ve/lab/<date>.json.
